query: After a fresh ComfyUI install, exported API-format workflows cannot be loaded when nodes are missing; error message is misleading and UI does not show which nodes are missing.

desired.outcome: Root cause: missing custom node packages (e.g. RIFE VFI). Installing all missing node packages resolves it. Bug in missing-node error reporting transferred to frontend repo Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend#7427.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
desired.answer_guidance: Root cause: missing custom node packages (e.g. RIFE VFI). Installing all missing node packages resolves it. Bug in missing-node error reporting transferred to frontend repo Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend#7427.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Detect silently-skipped missing custom nodes by probing the API (invalid_prompt 'node RIFE VFI does not exist') and enumerating/installing the absent packs.
